$comment: The autonomous-lane build envelope — the SINGLE source of truth for what an unattended Claude session may not change. Prose copies (CLAUDE.md, governor/SKILL.md, ship/SKILL.md, orient.md) cite this file rather than restating the list; restating it is how the wording drifted before (several copies dropped 'and hard to reverse' from CLAUDE.md's original). $openOnPurpose: Deliberately NOT protected (Eric, 2026-08-22 — 'gate money-moving logic only'): src/observatory/**, src/ui/**, src/three/**, and everything that merely RENDERS trades, P/L, leaderboards or bot cards. Presentation of trading data is ordinary buildable work. The honesty invariants (real tickers, truthful SIM/LIVE labels, paper-only) are a judgment stop stated in .github/prompts/feedback-build.md, not a path — no file list can enforce 'this flourish implies something false'.
